bug_specification.project_name: nullius — reducing legs must not reserve margin, the preflight must survive resting orders, and the alert must fit Telegram
bug_specification.bug_summary: Observed on the VST shadow book after bug_spec_vst_margin_partial_placement.xml merged (7ac5f1e3, 2026-10-24 ~05:00 UTC). Every slot since alternates between two failures. Slots at 04:00, 08:00 and 12:00 UTC complete with exit 1: the mirror places its five or six position-reducing legs as passive LIMIT orders, re-reads the balance, and the venue answers about 14.8 USDT available where it answered 636.25 before those orders were sent, so every increasing leg (48 to 50 of them) is deferred with margin_deferred. The venue reserves initial margin for a resting LIMIT order whatever its direction unless the order carries reduceOnly, and the mirror's reducing legs carry no reduceOnly, so the legs meant to free margin lock it. Slots at 16:00, 20:00 and 00:00 UTC abort in about one second with "bingx_refused: the venue answered code 101253 with 'Insufficient margin. Please adjust the leverage'": with the previous slot's reducing legs still resting, the preflight's per-symbol set_leverage preparation is refused by the venue, the refusal is not an already-set answer, and _prepare lets it abort the whole slot before the cancel of those resting orders has had any effect on margin. Each exit-1 slot also fires a Telegram alert whose body lists all 50 deferred legs and is refused with "Bad Request: message is too long" (the Bot API's 4096-character limit), so the one alert path that still works for refused slots delivers nothing. Opening equity drifted 9916.92 (10-24) to 9764.75 (10-25) to 9711.29 (10-26) while the book was partially reduced and never rebuilt.

bug.title: Position-reducing legs are sent as plain LIMIT orders, so the venue reserves initial margin for them and the legs meant to release margin lock it instead
bug.symptoms: Slot 2026-10-25T12:00 UTC: after the reducing legs were placed the balance re-read answered 14.7867 USDT against 636.2532 before; 50 increasing legs deferred ("this leg needs 13.666 USDT; 14.526 USDT of the 14.7867 USDT the account answered is already committed to the increasing legs admitted ahead of it"); exit 1. The same shape at 04:00 and 08:00 on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25.
bug.reproduction_steps: 1. Build a plan with reducing and increasing legs against a fake client whose balance() answers A before any order and A minus the sum of the reducing legs' notional at leverage 1 after any non-reduceOnly LIMIT order is placed (the venue's reservation), and A plus the released margin after a reduceOnly order. 2. Run mirror_place: the reducing legs go out without reduceOnly, the re-read balance is lower than A, and every increasing leg is deferred.
bug.expected: - bingx_orders.py (or wherever BingXOrder.parameters() is defined): BingXOrder gains an optional reduce_only field defaulting to the absent state; when set it is emitted in parameters() under bingx_flatten.REDUCE_ONLY_FIELD with the value bingx_flatten.BINGX_REDUCE_ONLY_TRUE (import the constants; do not restate the spellings). An order without the field emits exactly today's parameters, byte for byte. - bingx_mirror.py mirror_place: every leg whose _increasing_size is zero and whose _reducing_size is positive (it shrinks an existing position and never crosses zero) is sent with reduce_only set; a leg that would cross zero (reduce and re-open) is split into a reduceOnly leg of the held size and a plain leg for the remainder, each with its own client order id derived as the identity law derives a leg's id with a suffix the law allows, or, if the identity law admits no suffix, the crossing leg is sent plain as today and counted in a new report field crossing_legs. Reducing legs are still sent first; the balance re-read and admission logic are unchanged. - The order recorder and fidelity rows record the reduceOnly flag (one new nullable column or JSON field; a probe-then-ALTER as the member does elsewhere), so a reconciliation can tell a reduceOnly fill from a plain one. - Tests (new file): (a) a reducing leg's parameters() carries reduceOnly spelled as the flatten constant; a plain leg's parameters() equals the pre-fix dict; (b) the scenario above: with the fake client crediting released margin on reduceOnly orders, the re-read balance exceeds A and the increasing legs are admitted as the fake's margin allows; (c) a leg that would cross zero is handled per the chosen branch and counted; (d) a second run in the same slot places nothing (prior rows win) and the recorded flag is read back.
bug.actual: Reducing legs are plain LIMIT orders; the venue reserves margin for them; available collapses from 636 to 15 USDT; the plan's increasing legs are all deferred every slot.

bug.title: The preflight's per-symbol leverage preparation aborts the slot when the venue refuses set_leverage because orders are resting, so every slot after a slot that left resting orders fails before it can cancel them
bug.symptoms: Slots 16:00, 20:00 and 00:00 UTC on 2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25 and 04:00 UTC 2026-10-26: "bingx_rebalance: bingx_refused: the venue answered code 101253 with 'Insufficient margin. Please adjust the leverage' (feature 1)", about 1 s of CPU, no slot JSON, no completion row.
bug.reproduction_steps: 1. Fake client whose set_leverage(symbol, 1) raises the venue refusal code 101253 with msg "Insufficient margin. Please adjust the leverage" for a symbol that has a resting order, and answers the current leverage as 1 on the leverage GET. 2. run_bingx_preflight(client, required_usdt=0, symbols=[that symbol]) raises instead of returning a report.
bug.expected: - bingx_preflight.py: before writing margin type and leverage for a symbol, read the symbol's current arrangement through the client (the leverage GET at LEVERAGE_PATH, which answers the current leverage per side; margin type from the same document or positions()); when the arrangement already equals the preflight's (ISOLATED, leverage PREFLIGHT_LEVERAGE), skip both writes for that symbol. When a write is still needed and the venue refuses it with code 101253 while the current leverage already equals PREFLIGHT_LEVERAGE, treat the refusal as already-set (add a second judgement beside is_already_set_answer: is_leverage_in_force(refusal, current_leverage, wanted) that holds exactly when the code is 101253 and current equals wanted) and continue; when the current leverage differs, the refusal propagates as today. The report gains prepared_skipped (symbols whose arrangement was already in force) so the slot log shows how many writes were avoided. - Fixture set_leverage_refused_open_orders.json: the venue's 101253 refusal document and a leverage GET answer in the live fixture directory's shape (compose from the live quirks already pinned there; mark it as composed in the file's header comment if the exact capture is unavailable). - Tests (extend test_bingx_preflight.py): the scenario above returns a report with the symbol in prepared_skipped and nothing raised; a symbol whose current leverage is 2 and whose set_leverage is refused with 101253 still raises; a symbol already at ISOLATED/1 makes no set_margin_type or set_leverage call (count the fake's calls); the existing already-set path is unchanged.
bug.actual: _prepare absorbs only "already"/"no need to change" messages; 101253 propagates and the slot aborts before the cancel step clears the resting orders that caused it.

bug.title: The refused-slot alert lists every deferred leg and exceeds Telegram's message limit, so the alert is refused and the operator hears nothing
bug.symptoms: "bingx_alert: the Bot API refused the message (HTTP 400, error_code 400): Bad Request: message is too long" after every exit-1 slot since 2026-10-24 15:06 AEDT.
bug.reproduction_steps: 1. Compose the refused-slot alert for a report with 50 margin_deferred legs and call send_alert with a fake transport that records the body length. 2. The body exceeds 4096 characters; the real Bot API answers HTTP 400.
bug.expected: - bingx_alert.py: TELEGRAM_MAX_MESSAGE = 4096; send_alert truncates the formatted wire text to that length minus a short marker, appending "… [truncated, N chars]" so the head of the message (level, bot name, the first lines) always arrives; the truncation is applied after scrubbing and before posting; a message that fits is unchanged. - bingx_rebalance.py: the refused-slot body summarises before it lists: first line the counts by code (for example "deferred 50, refused 0, skipped 13, placed 6"), then the available and required margin figures, then at most the first 10 legs per code with a "+N more" line; the full list stays in the journal as today. - Tests (extend test_bingx_alert.py and test_bingx_rebalance.py): a 10 000-character body is posted at 4096 characters ending with the marker; a short body is posted unchanged; the composed refused-slot body for 50 deferred legs is under 2000 characters and begins with the counts line.
bug.actual: The alert body enumerates every deferred leg with its full message; the Bot API refuses it; no alert is delivered for any refused slot.
